text: APPROVE: The per-file logic is moved intact into `UnusedWriteScopeGrantsInFile` and `UnusedTopLevelGrants`, so result order, cancellation checks and the inverted top-level guard (`inheriting.Count > 0 && !Any(Opaque) && ... is { } top`) behave as before. The extracted helpers score about 11 each, and the original method is now a trivial loop. I found no compile or warning risk, assuming the original method was already `static` like its neighbours. I read the diff only and did not build it or run the tests.
